title: Signature Duo 47 · Glamour Hourglass × Glamour Hourglass · Najeon × Irezumi Waves · Cream Studio
prompt:
Subject: TWO Black women standing side by side, clearly separated with no overlap, one facing the camera and one turned away, showing the same extreme hourglass from the front and from behind.

Skin: Both women have THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH, blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, not brown, their faces the same deep tone with natural highlights and clearly defined features, not flat.

Left woman — mid 30s, sleek low bun with a mother-of-pearl binyeo. Glamour hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an overwhelmingly enormous full bust, a waist cinched so impossibly tiny it is barely a third of the width of her hips, hips flaring to nearly twice the width of her shoulders, thighs thicker than her waist pressing together, soft full voluptuous curves everywhere. Not skinny, not a runway model. Body Art: Full body najeon-chilgi painted directly on bare skin from neck to ankle. Deep glossy black lacquer densely inlaid with thick cut mother-of-pearl shell pieces with visible sharp cut edges, flashing pink, green, and blue iridescent sheen, not painted, real inlaid shell. Large peony blossoms and continuous vines spread wide across the bust and hips and narrow across the tiny waistline. Densely filled, covering the arms and legs completely.

Right woman — early 30s, sleek high bun with red lacquer kanzashi, pulled over one shoulder so the back is uncovered. Glamour hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an overwhelmingly enormous full bust, a waist cinched so impossibly tiny it is barely a third of the width of her hips, hips flaring to nearly twice the width of her shoulders, thighs thicker than her waist pressing together, soft full voluptuous curves everywhere. Not skinny, not a runway model. Body Art: Full body Japanese irezumi body painting painted directly on bare skin from neck to ankle. A bright indigo and white ground of continuous curling white-crested waves with vermilion and gold wind bars and scattered cherry petals. The waves spread wide across the bust and hips and narrow across the tiny waistline. A large continuous design spreads across the whole back and over the hips. Not black shading, no dragons, no koi. Densely filled, covering the arms and legs completely.

Pose: The left woman — standing in a wide stance with a strong hip shift, one hand resting lightly on her outer thigh, the other arm hanging relaxed away from the body. The right woman — standing with her back three-quarters to the camera, looking back over her shoulder with a smile, one arm hanging away from the body, the painted back, tiny waist, and flaring hips fully visible.

Footwear & Nails: The left woman wears extremely high black lacquer platform stiletto mules with mother-of-pearl studs; the right woman wears extremely high vermilion lacquer platform stiletto mules. Extra long nails.

Background & Lighting: A seamless warm cream studio backdrop with no props, the background much lighter than their bodies, soft warm light from one side carving the impossibly tiny waist, making every shell piece flash rainbow on the left and making the glossy colors gleam on the right, bright highlights on every glossy curve. 3:4 vertical 8K portrait, camera at waist height, 35mm lens.
